text:
Olivia CSM: Quick sync — EchoHealth saw another 503 spike last night (3rd in 10 days). Renewal flagged by AM. Can we capture action items and owners? :exclamation:
sam_cs: noted. timeline? they hit high error rate ~22:10 UTC.
diego_support: I have the incident logs, looks like route timeouts when cache miss rate > 85%.
incident-bot: Incident created: ECHO-503-2026-03-12 — Severity: P2 — link: https://app.redwood/incidents/ECHO-503-2026-03-12
rachel_se: adding context — customer uses dedicated pool with autoscale off (commit tier). KV cache TTL is 0.5s in their config.
matt_sre: initial hypothesis: cold KV cache + quantized model spin-up lag. need to confirm whether fallback to smaller model happened.
Olivia CSM: Action item: Diego to send trimmed logs + sample request ids by EOD. Owner: @diego_support :point_down:
diego_support: I’ll drop a filtered log set (500 lines) and the request ids in the thread by 18:00.
sam_cs: Action item: Rachel to validate their config and propose a safe KV TTL and autoscale policy. Owner: @rachel_se
rachel_se: Will validate and propose changes — target tomorrow morning. Suggest TTL 50ms or enable prefix caching.
matt_sre: Action item: I’ll run a quick repro on our staging with similar traffic pattern and try fallback path. Owner: @matt_sre — ETA 24h.
Olivia CSM: Escalation note for AM: if we don’t see improvement in 72h, recommend granting a temporary burst capacity and scheduled canary of non-quantized model. cc @sam_cs
sam_cs: I'll reach out to EchoHealth AM and log renewal risk (low->medium) with these mitigations.
diego_support: uploaded logs: https://files.redwood/echo-logs/trimmed-503s.log
rachel_se: Config snapshot attached: inline snippet
```
service.redis.kv_ttl_ms=500
dedicated.autoscale.enabled=false
model.quantize=int8
```
Olivia CSM: Next check-in: 24 hours. Please update thread when your item is done. :white_check_mark:
matt_sre: noted — will post repro results in thread.
sam_cs: thanks everyone. keeping AM updated.
Olivia CSM: closing loop — will prepare a short exec note after SRE confirmation.
